title: Personal Training Packages: deciding whether the loyalty bonus session is due
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states how the tier-eligibility and prior-grant check is combined with the tenure requirement to decide whether exactly one loyalty bonus session is due on a package.

## Rule
Exactly one complimentary loyalty bonus session is due on a package only where all of the following hold together: the package's own tier is eligible for the loyalty bonus session, no bonus session has yet been credited to that package, and the package has already met its own (possibly membership-accelerated) tenure requirement. Where any one of these three does not hold, no bonus session is due on that package.

## Points of judgement
All three conditions must hold together; none is sufficient on its own. A package on an eligible tier that has already met its tenure requirement but has already had a bonus session credited to it is not due a further one. A package that has met its tenure requirement and has not yet had a bonus session credited, but whose tier is not eligible, is not due one either. A package on an eligible tier with no bonus session yet credited, but that has not yet met its tenure requirement, is likewise not yet due one -- it becomes due only once the tenure requirement is met, provided the other two conditions still hold at that time.
